snippet.title: Monster Hunter Stories 3 - Princess of Azuria Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection is now available!
https://www.monsterhunter.com/stories3/en-us/products/

The Princess of Azuria soars to new heights in the launch trailer for Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - the next evolution of the turn-based, story-rich RPG series set in the world of Monster Hunter. Befriend, raise, and battle with iconic monsters in this vibrant, memorable, and expansive RPG adventure.

Available now on Nintendo Switch 2, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC/Steam.
  
Download the free demo and carry your save data over to the full game.
https://www.monsterhunter.com/stories3/en-us/trial/
